_comment: Datasets the manifest builder scans. Paths are relative to F1V2_DATA_ROOT. 'enabled': false entries are templates: download the dataset, check its folder names with `python -m feature1_v2.data.manifest --list-labels <name>`, fill 'label_map', then enable. Layouts: plantwild_trainval | split_folders | class_folders. Domain: field = real photos, lab = plain-background photos (never used in the benchmark).

sources.name: plantwild_v1
sources.citation: Wei et al. (2024) Benchmarking In-the-Wild Multimodal Plant Disease Recognition. ACM MM 2024. arXiv:2408.03120

sources.name: plantdoc
sources.citation: Singh et al. (2020) PlantDoc. CODS-COMAD 2020. doi:10.1145/3371158.3371196

sources.name: legacy_processed_v2
sources.citation: PlantVillage (Hughes & Salathe 2015), fgvc8 Plant Pathology 2021, cds, sms (Afzaal et al. 2022) -- as assembled by training/prepare_data_v2.py
sources.note: Domain per file: PlantVillage files contain '___' in the file name (lab); fgvc8/cds/sms files do not (field). All of it is training data only: v1 used these splits to choose models, so none of it enters the frozen benchmark.

sources.name: cucumber_extra

sources.name: eggplant_field

sources.name: okra_onion_melon_extra

sources.name: non_plant
sources.citation: any public non-plant photo set (e.g. a COCO val2017 subset) -- used to teach and test the 'not a supported leaf' output
